svg.title: One entry, two namespaces: what it is and where, and what it rests on
svg.text: The standard says what it is and where. The extension says what it rests on.
one entry: the certificate the records database serves after PostgreSQL's TLS upgrade
the ledger event the entry rests on:
the tool's raw output, by path and SHA-256;
no field is here without one
254 components: 47 on the wire, 182 in images, 9 listeners, 8 services, 8 images
